acquisition method: The mass spectrometer was operated in targeted mode (Parallel Reaction Monitoring –PRM).
alkylation reagent: Cells were then washed 2x with ice-cold HBSS, 0.1 mM iodoacetamide (IAA) ... reduced Cysteins were alkylated by addition of heavy-IAA
alkylation concentration: 0.1 mM iodoacetamide (IAA) ... heavy-IAA to a final concentration of 10 mM
cleavage agent: digestion buffer and 10 % trypsin (100 ng/μl in 10 mM HCl) were added to the beads
collision energy: a fixed normalized collision energy (NCE) of 30 % applying HCD activation.
enrichment method: protein enrichment by IP with anti-HA beads.
fragmentation method: a fixed normalized collision energy (NCE) of 30 % applying HCD activation.
instrument: LC-MS/MS analysis was performed on an Orbitrap Fusion Lumos (Thermo Scientific)
labeling: light and heavy iodoacetamide labeling (L- and H-IAA)

we quantified the degree of cysteine glutathionylation of sCGrx1p ([sCGrx1pSH]:[sCGrx1pSSG]) in the Golgi by a targeted proteomics approach using light and heavy iodoacetamide labeling (L- and H-IAA, respectively).
mass analyzer: Targeted MS2 scans were acquired in the Orbitrap mass analyzer at 60′000 resolution
ptm: Targeted MS2 scans covered the following masses (monoisotopic peptide ions): 724.8852 (DLIAENEIFVASK++), 957.9564 (TYC[+57.021464]PYSHAALNTLFEK++, light)
reduction reagent: Reduction of Cysteins was conducted by adding ∼2 % of TCEP (100 mM stock)
reduction concentration: Reduction of Cysteins was conducted by adding ∼2 % of TCEP (100 mM stock)
